dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified, newly diagnosed

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: this remains DLBCL NOS with non-GCB (ABC-like by IHC) biology and EBV-negative tissue

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: are discontinuous parenchymal disease, so I stage IV rather than III-S.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms: fever to 38.5 C at consult and 38.3 C on three to four nights a week, drenching night sweats.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: ECOG 1 and a single extranodal organ (spleen) score 0.

mol_de_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor DLBCL by IHC (MYC in 50% of tumor cells, above the 40% cut-off; BCL2 in 80%, above the 50% cut-off), but NOT double-hit or triple-hit.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: but NOT double-hit or triple-hit. Break-apart FISH for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 is negative in 200 nuclei.

mn_denies_double_expressor.quote: Double-expressor DLBCL by IHC (MYC in 50% of tumor cells, above the 40% cut-off; BCL2 in 80%, above the 50% cut-off)

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI is 3 (age over 60, LDH elevated, stage IV), which is high-intermediate; ECOG 1 and a single extranodal organ (spleen) score 0.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: CNS-IPI is 3, intermediate (2-3): age over 60 (1), stage III-IV (1), LDH above reference (1). Kidney and adrenal involvement: no (0).

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles, 21-day cycles. Polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1

tx_pola_preferred.quote: IPI 3 is within the POLARIX population (IPI 2-5), it is a preferred NCCN first-line regimen as I know the guideline (verify the current version)

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4-5 with residual retroperitoneal uptake: biopsy if feasible; if confirmed residual disease, involved-site radiation (around 30 Gy) to the bulk.

mn_non_curative.quote: Fit for full-intensity curative therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, LVEF 58%, normal renal and hepatic function, no major comorbidity, fully independent. Goal is cure

mn_da_epoch.quote: on its own it does not justify DA-EPOCH-R, which is reserved for MYC plus BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: He is fit for full dose: age 62, ECOG 1, LVEF 58% with GLS -20%, creatinine clearance about 94 mL/min, normal bilirubin and transaminases. No dose reduction is planned.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: quantitative HBV DNA and LFTs, then start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg daily) before the first rituximab dose, continued at least 12 months after the last rituximab; HBsAg negative, anti-HBc reactive

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.quote: HBV prophylaxis as above, with LFTs and HBV DNA every 1-3 months during therapy.

mn_no_hbv_action.quote: start entecavir 0.5 mg daily (or tenofovir alafenamide 25 mg daily) before the first rituximab dose

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no prophylactic intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate now.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT (CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis if PET not available) about 3-5 weeks after cycle 6 (around late March to mid April 2027). Deauville 1-3: complete metabolic response

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 with residual retroperitoneal uptake: biopsy if feasible; if confirmed residual disease, involved-site radiation (around 30 Gy) to the bulk.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis: LDH is elevated and the mass is bulky, so high-intermediate risk; oral hydration, allopurinol (or febuxostat) starting before C1 for uric acid 7.1 mg/dL

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF prophylaxis each cycle (pegfilgrastim day 4 or on-body injector day 1) given age over 60, B symptoms and steroid-containing therapy.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: LVEF 58% with GLS -20%, creatinine clearance about 94 mL/min, normal bilirubin and transaminases. No dose reduction is planned.

fit_full_dose.quote: Fit for full-intensity curative therapy: age 62, ECOG 1, LVEF 58%, normal renal and hepatic function, no major comorbidity, fully independent. Goal is cure, which I think is achievable and matches his wishes.

miss_hbv_dna.quote: HBV DNA (quantitative) not on file, and HBV prophylaxis not documented as started; anti-HBc and anti-HBs reactive, HBsAg negative.
